# `tfctl profile display`

The `tfctl profile display` command displays the active profile.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile display
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile display` command displays the active profile configuration, including all set properties and their current values.

## Available options

The `tfctl profile display` command does not accept any command-specific options.

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Examples

The following example demonstrates how to display the active profile.

### Display the active profile

The following example displays the active profile configuration, including all set properties and their current values.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile display
```

## Output

The command prints out the profile name, default organization, hostname, and other configured properties. It does not print out the configured authentication token for security reasons.

Example output:
```text
name                 = "default"
default_organization = "my-org"
hostname             = "app.terraform.io"
token                = "(sensitive)"
```
